'''Mia Hazelsprout''' is a [[human]] located in [[Ambershire]] in [[Northwind]].

==Quotes==
;Gossip
My father used to fish in this small pond, but he would never take the fish home. I think he felt a certain sadness for them—raised, essentially, in captivity, in a small, limited place to roam. I wonder if that's how he felt about our home when he decided to join the [[Defias Brotherhood|Defias]]. Mh, I suppose he got the opposite of what he wanted in the [[Stockades]].
